newsitem.title: USA: HOT STOCK HIGHLIGHTS - Corporate Earnings.
newsitem.headline: HOT STOCK HIGHLIGHTS - Corporate Earnings.

text.p: The company reported third-quarter earnings per share of $0.68 against $0.65 for the same period in 1995. The First Call estimate was $0.82.
Prudential Securities pulled Xerox off its "best idea" list. However, analyst B. Alexander Henderson kept his buy rating for the stock.
The company's third-quarter operating share rose to $1 from $0.68 and the net share rose to $1 from $0.79. The First Call estimate had been $0.85.

The company reported third-quarter earnings per share of $0.61 vs $0.51 in the same period in 1995. The First Call estimate had been $0.59 a share. Hershey said it saw a loss of $45 million on disposal of its two European confectionery interests.
Finland's Huhtamaki Oy said it planned to sell its Leaf North America confectionery operations and license its brands to Hershey.
The company reported third quarter earnings per share of $0.39 against $0.55 a year ago. It maintained its quarterly dividend of $0.35.
The company reported first-quarter earnings per share profit of $0.17 against a loss of $0.14 in the same period a year ago.
The company reported a second-quarter loss per share of $0.24 against a loss of $0.11 in the same period a year ago.
The company reported after the market's close on Thursday a third-quarter loss per diluted share of $0.77 against a profit of $0.36 for the same period a year before.
